# CSPNeuralEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of mapping constraint satisfaction problem variables and constraints onto spiking neuron populations and synaptic connectivity patterns. Provides a biologically plausible and energy-efficient representation of discrete optimization problems for in-network neuromorphic processing.
